2610.13640.title: Learning Size Independent Constraint Models from Input Data and Positive and Negative Example Solutions
2610.13640.paper_summary: In this paper we describe a Constraint Acquisition Tool that generates size independent constraint programs from input data and positive and negative example solutions of multiple problem instances. The system finds size specific models based on typical constraint patterns over global and binary constraints, then generalizes the models to a size independent model that can be run on unseen input data. The system produces MiniZinc code as well as a textual description of the model. We evaluate the tool on the example problems of the PTHG21 Challenge and show the feasibility of the approach.
2610.13640.paper_summary_zh: 在本文中，我們描述了一個約束獲取工具，它從輸入數據以及多個問題實例的正例和負例解生成與大小無關的約束程序。該系統基於全局和二元約束的典型約束模式尋找特定大小的模型，然後將這些模型概括為可以在未見輸入數據上運行的與大小無關的模型。該系統生成 MiniZinc 代碼以及模型的文本描述。我們在 PTHG21 挑戰的示例問題上評估了這個工具，並展示了該方法的可行性。
